description: This file contains React components and style constants for the Ocean theme used across a frontend project. It includes UI components such as Card, Button, Input, Select, TextArea, and DataTable, which facilitate consistent UI design and reusability.

methods.name: Card
methods.description: A reusable card component with optional header elements and children content.

methods.name: Button
methods.description: A customizable button component with variants, sizes, and optional icons.

methods.name: Input
methods.description: A styled input component with support for labels, hints, and error messages.

methods.name: Select
methods.description: A select dropdown component with options and label support.

methods.name: TextArea
methods.description: A styled textarea component with label support.

methods.name: DataTable
methods.description: A table component that displays data with customizable columns and empty state message.
